links.evidence: Samsung Electronics, Co., Ltd. (Samsung), accounted for approximately 7% , 14% and 25% of our total revenue in fiscal years 2016 , 2015 and 2014 , respectively.
No customer other than Walmart accounted for 10 percent or more of our consolidated net sales.
One of our customers, Han's Laser, headquartered in China, accounted for 12%, 13% and 9% of our net sales in 2018, 2017 and 2016, respectively.
Tech Data accounted for 37% and 35% of our total net revenue for fiscal 2021 and 2020, respectively
We announced an agreement with Nissan Motor Co. Ltd. in 2013 to supply our light-duty diesel engine and began commercial shipment in 2015.
For 2014, Corning’s sales to Samsung Display Co. Ltd., a customer of our Display Technologies segment, represented 14% of the Company’s consolidated net sales.
our share of the U.S. pre-tax Nexavar ® commercial profits that were generated from our collaboration with Bayer HealthCare Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Bayer)
In the United Kingdom, we partner in a cost-sharing arrangement with another supplier, Bacardi Limited, to sell a portfolio of both companies’ brands.
Our competitors include but are not limited to: • Maxim Integrated Products, Inc.
The primary competitor for our McAfee family of security products and services is Symantec Corporation.
PACCAR is our largest customer, accounting for 16 percent of our consolidated net sales in 2022, 15 percent in 2021 and 15 percent in 2020.
